The Hand Tool Wall and Cabinets in the Garage. Keeps the tools you reach for weekly visible, findable, and provably all present.

What done looks like:
1. Every hand tool hanging on its own drawn outline with no blank silhouettes
2. One adjustable wrench at chest height nearest the door
3. Saw teeth sheathed
4. The cabinet latched
